description: Defines the GraphingSettingsViewModel class for managing graph settings in a calculator app, including properties for axis ranges, error states, and trig modes, with methods for updating display ranges and setting the grapher.

classes.name: GraphingSettingsViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class for managing graph settings, including axis ranges, error states, trig modes, and interactions with the graph control.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayRange
methods.description: Updates the display range of the graph based on current properties.

methods.name: SetGrapher
methods.description: Associates a Grapher object with the view model.

methods.name: ResetView
methods.description: Resets the graph view to default.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if there are any errors in the current settings.
